name: OrphanCare Foundation
summary: Works so that children in institutions and unplanned newborns can grow up in a family, through baby hatches, adoption and reintegrating children with their families.
programmes: Counselling for women with unplanned pregnancies
impact: Nine baby hatches operating in Peninsular Malaysia as of November 2025 (FMT, 20 Nov 2025)
81 Baby Hatch rescues in 2024 up to November, up from 55 in 2023 (NST, Dec 2024)
More than 400 of 639 rescued babies legally adopted (NST, Dec 2024)
beneficiaries: Abandoned or unplanned newborns, children in institutions, women facing unplanned pregnancies, adoptive families

organisation.founders: The late Dato' Adnan Mohd Tahir, who founded it with a group of friends and was its first president (died 2011); first registered as 'Pertubuhan Kebajikan Dan Pengurusan Anak-Anak Yatim, Kuala Lumpur (OrphanCARE)', then re-established as OrphanCare Foundation in 2012
organisation.leadership: Tan Sri Faizah binti Mohd Tahir (Chairman); Zakiah A Rahman (General Manager, per FMT Nov 2025)
